dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: #Looking good there, {NICKNAME}! Now, we have several dance groups here and all kinds of stages set up, so you can dance till you drop if you like!

choices.text: Then let's get started!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Woohoo! Alright, dancers on your marks! Music, stand by... Take the stage, coach!

choices.text: Nusta, could I have a quick word with you first? Nothing too serious.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Sure! We can chat as long as you like. Just, ah, hold on a sec...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Mmm, I'm good, just a lil' tipsy! So, what do you want to talk about, dear hero?

choices.text: Did you enjoy your trip to Sumeru?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Haha, of course! I couldn't be happier! Besides that little Wenut incident, we also encountered so many fascinating people and things—

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: A team of four chefs hailing from different nations, shuttling between Sumeru and Fontaine, rustling up amazing dishes no matter the ingredients that land in their laps...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: A beast tamer returning from the far desert with her Fungus companions, her ladylike demeanor strikingly juxtaposed against her Eremite dress...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Not to mention the female mercenary with the pretty pigtails, an expert with her twin blades who loves dancing around the bonfire at night...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I have to say, it doesn't feel right having you stand here chatting with me without a drink or some snacks in hand.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: How about I buy you a nice meal when you have some time? Then we can chat as we eat!

choices.text: How are your people doing these days?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Whoa! First, I must thank you for your concern on their behalf.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Two of the four were injured in battle, but it's nothing serious. They've just about recovered at this point.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: If anything, they're all bursting with energy right now. How about we go and get some practice in with them sometime?

choices.text: So, what's next for you?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Mmm... besides coaching boxing and dance, I think I'd like to try my hand at playing in a band too.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Master Iansan taught me a lot about drumming when the Collective of Plenty came to help our tribe. I'm really digging it!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I did see you and her from a distance while at the Easybreeze Resort... That's right, I should say that I saw the Pyro Archon's band in action.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Once I get good enough at the drums, I'll play for you! Whatever song you call, I'll do my best to make it perfect!

choices.text: Let's exchange some pointers about dance in a bit!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Of course! Nothing beats dancing with everyone after I've had my fill at the dinner table!

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Hello, esteemed traveler! I'm truly delighted to meet you here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been a while since I last saw you, Miss Taraneh...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Ah, didn't expect you to remember me! My performance spot is a bit off the beaten path, after all...

choices.text: I've heard people talking about your dance skills in a few places...

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: I'm so grateful to hear that... It's possibly the highest compliment one could receive! I'll keep improving so I can inspire even more people with my dancing.

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: The most important thing is to live your life well and share your positivity with everyone around you!

choices.text: Just thinking about your dance lifts my spirits!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about a game of Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Huh? Here?

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: But... Eh, I guess it's fine. Playing a couple of rounds of Genius Invokation TCG while traveling seems perfectly reasonable.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Well, it'll be my honor then!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Nilou! Nilou! Come try this!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I shaped the samosas the way you like it, and placed them into a broth made with greenwave sunfish, sprayfeather gill, and pepper...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: After letting them simmer for half an hour, I then dried the samosas on low heat... It tastes totally different now, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Mmm... hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Mmm! Amazing, it's like... I'm tasting waves and waves coming in... There's an additional pep to the clear, clean taste of the dish!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: The crunchiness of the samosa makes the savory meat filling burst with every bite, weaving a rhythm filled with joy...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Just one bite, and many lively, cheerful melodies for the lyre are coming to mind already!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Heh. As soon as Nusta showed me the recipe, I just knew a snack like this would work perfectly with the seafood we have here in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: And it's quite a substantive snack, which makes it a great pick-me-up for after dance practices.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Then let's get cracking on a few more snacks for our dancers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon can't stand listening to this anymore... she wants some of that so bad!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Is that {NICKNAME} and Paimon I see? You two are finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Awesome! Our distinguished guests {NICKNAME} and Paimon have arrived!

choices.text: Looks like we got here a little late...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Mmhmm! Nilou and I have been getting to know each other all day. If you came this morning, you could've joined me in taking her on a tour of the People of the Springs!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Ah! I can't believe that my trusted partner, the hero of all Natlan, someone just as important as the host, has failed to properly welcome our distinguished guests who've come such a long way...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hehe! You ought to be punished for that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—P—Punished...? How?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Your punishment is to stick with Nilou and I for the rest of the day and eat our attempts at Natlan-Sumeru fusion food until you drop!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: And when night comes, if Nilou's too excited to fall asleep, you'll have to tell her sweet bedtime stories until she drifts off to dreamland...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew... That does sound like a Mualani-style "punishment," that's for sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's sure we could take double or triple that. Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Yes, ma'am! Your wish is my command!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #Ahahaha! I like your commitment to the bit, {NICKNAME}! You must be in a good mood, huh?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Mmm, in that case, I don't think I'll be able to sleep at all...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: #Wait, I mean... You're {NICKNAME}'s superior amongst the tribal warriors, Mualani...?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Haha! Of course not! We're just kidding! I'm just mimicking the serious way Amina speaks!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #I mean, if we're going by experience and battlefield achievements, I should be {NICKNAME}'s subordinate instead...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #Or, to use a recently trending light novel trope, I'd be {NICKNAME}'s "Captain of the Guard"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Captain of the Guard"? That's quite an impressive title...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Huh. So much so that "Advisor" kinda pales in comparison...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Well, according to Miss Sole of the Deep's "A Brief Overview of Light Novel Tropes," apart from the role of advisor, you'd also be considered a "Lucky Star," Paimon...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #In other words, you bring {NICKNAME} luck with Mora even when you do nothing at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh heh, Paimon's a fan of this role for sure! Zero fights, but lotsa influence!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: And if we are to stick to that pattern, then you'd be our "Friendly Magic Teacher Next Door," Nilou...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I mean, we're about the same age, but you're incredibly knowledgeable. And you have this gentle, subtle way of making profound ideas easy for everyone to understand.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Huh? Shouldn't I be... some kind of a "Helper Who Bestows Blessings" instead?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Besides, I don't really know anything profound...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: That's what you call being a natural talent!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: All you did was to perform a simple little dance in front of the saurians, and several of them have already learned how to keep to the beat.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: The other warriors also caught on to the basic steps pretty quickly after your explanation.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #I'm sure that everyone will truly discover the joy of dancing once they nail the rhythm part under {NICKNAME}'s guidance!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon will soon see how quickly our dancers have made progress thanks to you working your magic!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I appreciate the kind words, but you're giving me too much credit...

choices.text: Well, I'm a believer in Nilou's magic!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #Great! So don't worry, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Just let your hair down at our first-ever Dance Exchange! Feel free to show everyone your passion!

choices.text: And I'll come in with the perfect finale!
I'll be sure to have the best bedtime stories on hand!
Did we miss a memo or something...?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to run into you again so soon after our last meeting. Certainly not in a different nation... Hehe, you have no idea how at ease and happy that makes me feel!

choices.text: I'm glad to see you too.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: It was definitely the right decision to come on this trip...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: It happened just after Lesser Lord Kusanali had left the Zubayr Theater. That was when Miss Taraneh came to us with a cart full of gifts and explained the details of this dance exchange event.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I was a bit worried about coming to Natlan since I had heard the locals are passionate about their battle techniques. I wasn't sure if I'd run into really scary, aggressive people here.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But I was pleasantly surprised by what I discovered here. It turns out that the people here in Natlan aren't obsessed with battle or fanatics or anything like that. They're just people who train with vigor and are always pushing themselves to become better.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: In particular, I found Miss Nusta's group to be full of energy and joy. Thanks to them, I've made several adorable saurian friends!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Every tribe's saurians have their own charms. They all have these beautiful colors and such soft, gentle voices. When I spend time with them, the whole day just slips by before I know it...

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: Which type of saurian do you like best, Nilou?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: They're all so adorable. I don't really have a "favorite" to speak of at this time...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: The Yumkasaurus and Iktomisaurus were so drawn to the Sumeru Rose scent from the face powder I use that they kept circling me the first time we met.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Surprisingly, the Tatankasaurus and Qucusaurus took a liking to the Candied Ajilenakh Nuts we brought. They'd eat their fill, then fall asleep by our bonfire. Sometimes, I could even hear them snoring faintly.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: The Koholasauruses are all so well-behaved and listen to Mualani. Some of them even make sure to wash their little feet before they help Miss Taraneh and the others with the laundry...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Oh, there's also a Tepetlisaurus that seems really interested in dance rhythms. I hear that she's a regular performer over at the Children of Echoes.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Hopefully that saurian will be able to fully master the fundamentals of dance with your coaching.

choices.text: I've got confidence!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Go for it! But please make sure to conserve your energy. It's best to just relax and have fun instead of exhausting yourself.

choices.text: I'll give it my best shot!
Did you have fun with Mualani?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Mmhmm! It feels like... I was able to unleash all of myself? That was amazing...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I'm meeting Mualani for the first time, but incredibly, she doesn't feel like a stranger at all... Everything feels so natural and easy with her.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Miss Taraneh even says that when we talk to each other, it's like we're two long-lost sisters.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I might be exaggerating a bit, but it wouldn't be far off to say we're getting along like childhood friends.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Sometimes, I feel a bit uneasy when I come across things that are completely unfamiliar to me here in Natlan.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: For example, when I first started interacting with the adult saurians, I'd subconsciously slow my breathing and watch them closely for any signs of hostility...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But with Mualani's help, I started to build up the courage to interact with the saurians and ease into the local activities. Little by little, I began to enjoy things the way my friends in Natlan do.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Her willingness to try new things, and the way she actively seeks out different things that give her joy... She's really such an inspiration to me.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: It feels like I'm basking in the afternoon sun, with both my body and mind wrapped in a gentle warmth...

choices.text: If I have any questions about dancing, I'll be coming to you for help!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Sure! I'll be here waiting for you during this time.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Heyoo! How does it feel to lead everyone in dance, {NICKNAME}? Were you surprised to see your Sumeru friends here among the People of the Springs?

choices.text: Dancing makes me feel good!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Heh, glad to hear that!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: With this wonderful start, we've become fast friends and allies with The Eremites' Blazing Beasts!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I hope we can have exchanges like this regularly. It'd be so wonderful for everyone to come together and dance freely, without a care in the world.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It'd be like, like... a monthly get-together among friends! Nothing too fancy or formal. Just relaxed, spontaneous, and fun!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Who knows, maybe it won't be long before we come up with a Natlan-Sumeru fusion dance style that blends the passion of our rolling plains with the wild energy of Sumeru's desert...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Oh, oh, that might be a bit intense. Maybe that's better suited for a war-dance instead?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Then... how about "the warm steam of the hot springs, mingled with the rich, complex scent of flowers from the rainforest... a sensation both dynamic and elegant"?

choices.text: I'm all for everyone getting together and learning from each other!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Heh, actually, I did also invite Kachina to join us this time.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Unfortunately, she's busy "honing some sort of new skill in private." She also mentioned she's preparing some kind of gift for the two of you...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Also, shh! Don't tell her I told you that! This stays between us, 'kay?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: You'll find out what that mystery gift is the next time you see her!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: As for future dance exchanges, you can count on me. They're gonna be a blast!

choices.text: Let's invite more friends next time!
Surprise, Nilou!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hoho! I didn't know you knew such an amazing dancer. You should've introduced us sooner!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Watching Nilou dance has opened my eyes to a whole new world...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Dance as I knew it was mostly as a way to let all my energy out.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It'd give me a powerful energy boost, lift my mood, and also prepare my body for other forms of physical activity, even combat.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It was only after watching Nilou dance that I realized how even slow movements and gentle music can touch the heart so deeply.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I'm not sure how to put it in words... It was like she was wrapped in that glow you see along the edge of the Spiritway. All I could say was "Beautiful," and "I want to see you do that again"...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Honestly, if Nilou danced all day, I'd sit down and watch her the whole time!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Ha! But I kid! I wouldn't want to tire her out like that!

choices.text: You should meet my other friends too!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Why, are you trying to entice me into following you around all the time?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: But as tempting as it sounds... I know better than to trouble you like that!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: So, whenever you're ready, just call me, or swing by People of the Springs with your friends. I'd love to meet them!

choices.text: I count all kinds of experts and pros among them!
Awesome! That sounds like all kinds of fun!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hahaha! Then be sure to bring your dance-loving friends around more, y'hear?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
dialogues.text: #Hold on a second... Boss {NICKNAME}? So you're the "VIP guest" Miss Nusta was talking about?

choices.text: We... met in Fontaine, didn't we?

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: That's right! I was there to help a director with an event, and I even applied for a job at your movie theater!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: But running into you again here in south Natlan... Heh, what are the odds? If I'd known, I would've roped Dehya in too.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Too bad she's tied up with something else. I'm sure she’d love this — and she'd totally hit it off with that pro surfer too!

choices.text: I did run into her recently!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Isn't she? Over the years, there's been more and more contact between the rainforest and the desert peoples.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Apart from her work managing the Blazing Beasts, she's also always coordinating things between the two sides alongside Miss Candace.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: That kinda work just isn't something simple folks like us get, y'know?

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: As such, quite a few of us have started picking up things like arithmetic, hoping to help lighten Dehya's load as soon as we can...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: When that day comes, you'll see Dehya on vacation everywhere!

choices.text: She's another busy bee, that's for sure!
Sorry, I'm not sure if we've met before...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: #That's alright! I'm one of Dehya's lads. You're her most important friend, and that makes you our {M#big brother}{F#big sister} too!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: We'll follow your lead when we're out there! After this get-together, just say the word, and your brothers here will be there to take care of any problem.

choices.text: That's alright, my good fellow. Relax!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Fair enough... With your skills, you can handle enemies no matter where you are anyway. Besides, I could stand to relax a bit instead of being ready to draw my scimitar everywhere I go.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Even Natlan's fiercest warriors are just focused on perfecting their combat skills. Honor is also very important to them as fighters.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: I guess this means I won't have to worry about Taraneh anymore, except maybe when she's traveling along that stretch of desert west of Wadi Al-Majuj. She might even be able to travel on her own someday...

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: Taraneh?

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Oh, she's the daughter of one of my brothers. I've known her since she was a child!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Taraneh's father took an arrow that'd have otherwise killed me...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: He spent a few years recovering after that. Unfortunately, he got a bit out of shape during that time, so he ended up going into the goods transport business instead.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: These days, he's doing pretty well over at Port Ormos, and even invites the whole lot of us over for a good meal and drinks every couple of months or so.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: In fact, he's the one who's footing the bill for Miss Nilou and the rest of them this time.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: (Lets out sigh of relief)

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Here's a funny story for you. After meeting little Nusta on the road, we decided to come to Natlan. Since we were going to dance, I thought we'd bring Taraneh along too..

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: But because Taraneh ain't the most confident in her dancing, she wanted to ask Miss Nilou to be the consultant on this trip. But the poor girl was hesitant about that too, because guess what, she'd never even talked to her idol before.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: So we suggested that Dehya write a letter of introduction and send it along with a bunch of gifts. And it worked!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Then, when they got here, they ran into that pro surfer too, and everyone really hit it off... It's been such a relief for Taraneh's father and I to see them so happy here.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: I reckon Taraneh will finally be able to shake off that rough patch she was stuck in after this trip.

choices.text: That's a good thing!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Yeah, it just goes to show how much spending time with good, cheerful friends and getting out can do for a person's head.

choices.text: I'm so happy for her!
Let's just take it easy and enjoy this peaceful vacation, shall we?
Alright, you must be busy, so I shan't keep you any longer. Let's chat again later!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Don't worry about me! I'll be around whenever.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Our friends from Sumeru are so warm and friendly! And the gifts they brought, especially those specialty dishes and ingredients, are great too!

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Next time, I should plan things out with Mualani ahead of time so we can be better prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: We need to make sure they get our best dishes! But at the same time, they don't like things to be too formal or stuffy, so we'll have to find the right balance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be going now.

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: All right, see you later!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "Good times always slip away so fast..."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Nah, I won't say that! Instead, let's make this gathering a regular thing!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Yes! I can't wait for the day someone sneaks up behind me at the Zubayr Theater, covers my eyes, and asks me to guess who they are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't forget to call us when the time comes!

choices.text: We'll be here to see you perform together onstage.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #Hah, I'm holding you to that promise, {NICKNAME}! And you too, Paimon!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Mualani also gave me some flower seeds from areas near the People of the Springs. I'll make sure they bloom beautifully and add even more charm to the stage!

choices.text: We'll take you on a proper tour of the Grand Bazaar.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll have to go prepare for the journey back.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
dialogues.text: #I'll see you again, {NICKNAME}!
